macro.title: Wendy’s Stock Is Changing Hands More Than Micron. The Nasdaq Halts Trading. - Barron's

macro.title: Supreme Court blocks thousands of suits claiming Roundup causes cancer - The Washington Post
macro.summary: The ruling restricts one of the largest waves of product liability lawsuits in the history of the nation. Weed killer Roundup was sold by chemical giant Monsanto.

macro.summary: First-quarter GDP grew at 2.1%, above the expected 1.6%, as equipment investment in AI and computers along with consumer spending led growth.
